name: Fiction Paradox
source:
Rebel against the fate of humanity in a unique adventure to change the world. Sci-fi visual novel with optional adult content and romance. You can play as a female or male protagonist.

-----------

Year 2045. The world is evolving faster than ever, but your life feels empty and meaningless. Driven by your powerful imagination, you decide to embark on a journey to become an inventor and change the future of humanity.

Throughout this adventure, you will meet different people with whom you'll share experiences, form deep bonds, and explore the boundaries of friendship, love, and the most intimate desires. Conventional values are not obstacles to you, but limits meant to be surpassed. Will you be able to illuminate the darkness of the world, or will you be consumed by it?
translation:
在一次独特的冒险中反抗人类的命运，改变世界。科幻视觉小说，可选成人内容和浪漫内容。你可以扮演女性或男性主角。

------------

2045年。世界的发展速度比以往任何时候都快，但你的生活却感到空虚和毫无意义。在强大想象力的推动下，你决定踏上成为发明家并改变人类未来的旅程。

在整个冒险过程中，你将遇到不同的人，与他们分享经历，建立深厚的联系，并探索友谊、爱情和最亲密欲望的界限。传统价值观对你来说不是障碍，而是需要超越的界限。你能照亮世界的黑暗，还是会被它吞噬？
